name: Cambridge Side Events Winter 2023
information:
This is a **side-events** competition, focusing on the atypical events held at WCA Competitions, anyone is welcome to come and compete!

f you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the information in the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.

**FMC** is the main event of this competition
